question: What is the primary focus of the S. Ramakrishnan Centre of Excellence in Fluid and Thermal Science Research 2025?

options.text: Critical advancements in spacecraft and launch vehicle thermal management

solution:
The correct answer is __**Critical advancements in spacecraft and launch vehicle thermal management**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The S. Ramakrishnan Centre of Excellence focuses on cutting-edge research in **fluid and thermal sciences**, aimed specifically at improving spacecraft and launch vehicle thermal management systems.
 
• It plays a pivotal role in enhancing the **thermal control mechanisms** required for space exploration and satellite technology.
 
• Thermal management in spacecraft is critical to ensure operational efficiency, preventing overheating or freezing in extreme space environments.
 
• The research conducted at the center supports the development of advanced **cooling systems, heat shields, and thermal protection materials** for launch vehicles.
 
• The center collaborates with leading scientists, engineers, and institutions to foster innovation in the field of aerospace thermal management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thermal Management in Spacecraft:**

 
 
• Spacecraft face extreme temperatures ranging from freezing cold to intense heat, making thermal management systems vital for survival and functionality.
 
• Techniques include active cooling systems, radiators, heat pipes, and thermal insulation materials.
 
• Thermal shields prevent damage during re-entry into Earth's atmosphere.
 
 
 
• **Fluid and Thermal Science:**
 
 
• This field focuses on the behavior of fluids and heat transfer mechanisms in various systems, including aerospace applications.
 
• Research in fluid dynamics helps optimize fuel usage and propulsion systems for launch vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Launch Vehicle Technologies:**
 
 
• Launch vehicles require robust thermal systems to protect sensitive equipment during liftoff and operation.
 
• Advancements in thermal science improve launch vehicle efficiency, payload capacity, and reliability.
 
 
 
• **Applications in Space Exploration:**
 
 
• Thermal management research benefits satellite technology, interplanetary missions, and human space exploration.
 
• Improved systems ensure the safety of astronauts and scientific instruments in harsh space conditions.
